response.sql: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM group_counts), avg_shares AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_share FROM avg_shares WHERE share > avg_share;
